title: Droplet infection
description: An unfinished mod featuring an extremely potent airborne pathogen. Transmission occurs through respiratory droplets with devastating efficiency. Stay tuned.
body:
**_Droplet Infection_**

A brand-new infection-themed mod, currently in early development.

Current Content
A handful of infected entities have been added so far—not many in number, and not particularly powerful on their own. But don't let that fool you.

Core Mechanic
The real threat lies in its infection system: the pathogen spreads via droplet transmission with extreme contagiousness, capable of infecting the vast majority of living entities in the game. Common animals, hostile mobs, and even some unexpected beings—almost nothing is immune.

Coming Soon
More infected variants, evolutionary forms, and containment gameplay are in active development. Stay tuned for future updates.

**_飞沫感染 (Droplet Infection)_**

这是一个全新的类感染主题模组，目前仍处于早期开发阶段。

当前内容
模组现已加入若干感染生物实体，数量不多，强度亦不算顶尖——但请切勿因此掉以轻心。

核心机制
真正令人警惕的是其感染体系：病原体通过飞沫传播，传染性极强，能够侵染游戏中绝大多数生物实体。无论是常见的动物、敌对怪物，还是某些你意想不到的存在，几乎都难逃此劫。

未来展望
更多感染变种、进化形态与防疫玩法正在开发中，敬请期待后续更新。
